usedFor: ButterCMS sends content events such as “Post Published”, and Summarize Text condenses the provided text with “Summarize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “Post Published” in ButterCMS, then “Summarize Text” in Summarize Text
bestTemplate.why: A published blog post gets a concise summary of its text, ready for the next step.

watchOut: “Create Post” in ButterCMS is polling, unlike its hook triggers, so a new post reaches Summarize Text on a schedule.
